title: B-linearity of the transported pullback counit
statement: Let $f:U\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $A=f_*\mathcal O_U$, $\rho:\mathcal O_X\to A$ the structure map, $R$ pushforward of modules to A-module sheaves and $S$ restriction along $\rho$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $I=f^{-1}$ on A-modules and $IA=f^{-1}A$, $r_0:f^{-1}\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal O_U$ for the structure map, $t_0=f^{-1}\rho$, and $e:IA\to\mathcal O_U$ for the ring-sheaf counit. Let $b:\mathcal O_U\to B$ and $t:IA\to B$ form a pushout of $r_0,t_0$, and let $\epsilon:B\to\mathcal O_U$ satisfy $b\epsilon=1$ and $t\epsilon=e$. Let $P$ be a functor from A-module sheaves to B-module sheaves, with specified identifications $P(G)=B\otimes_{IA}I(G)$ and map $P(a)$ the transported sheafification of $1\otimes I(a)$. Let $\kappa:P\operatorname{Res}_b\simeq S f^*$ be a natural isomorphism, where $f^*$ is tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. All tensor products are scalar-first and sheafified [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Assume for every open $V$ of X and $g\in G(V)$ that $\kappa_G^{-1}(\eta^{f^*}_{SG,V}(g))=\theta_t(1\otimes\eta^{\mathrm{ab}}_{G,V}(g))$ over $f^{-1}V$, where $\theta_t$ is the tensor sheafification unit and $\eta^{\mathrm{ab}}$ the abelian inverse-image unit, and $\eta^{f^*}$ is the unit of the canonical adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Then for each $\mathcal O_U$-module sheaf F there is a B-linear morphism $\delta_F:P(RF)\to\operatorname{Res}_\epsilon F$ whose underlying section map on every open W sends p to $\operatorname{counit}_F(\kappa_{RF}(p))$. Thus only the scalar linearity of the transported counit is asserted; no factorization through H or epimorphy is asserted.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 01SB (lemma-affine-equivalence-modules), construction of h and elucidation

proof.text: Let q be the O_U-linear composite of kappa with the canonical pullback counit. The canonical pullback unit formula and hP identify its value on theta_t(1 tensor eta(g)) with g viewed as a section of F over f inverse V. This is the adjunction triangle.

The inverse-image module adjunction gives the inverse-image counit I(RF) to F, linear over IA for the action through e. Evaluate c tensor s as epsilon(c) times that counit of s. The equality t epsilon=e makes the map balanced, and the formula is B-linear. It commutes with restrictions and sheafifies to delta.

The evaluation delta and q agree on the unit images from the first step. The pushout identifies Res_b P(RF) with O_U tensor over f inverse O_X of I(RF). Inverse-image unit sections locally generate I(RF), and their O_U multiples locally generate this tensor sheaf. Both delta and q are O_U-linear, the former by b epsilon=1. Thus equality on those unit sections extends to all local sections and hence to all sections. The section formula determines delta uniquely, including empty opens and zero rings.

proof_origin.note: Expanded the B-linearity step in the construction of h in Stacks 01SB.

theorem affine_module_tensor_counitLinear
    (B : U.toTopCat.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u}) (b : U.sheaf ⟶ B) (t : IA ⟶ B)
    (ε : B ⟶ U.sheaf) (hpush : IsPushout r₀ t₀ b t)
    (hb : b ≫ ε = 𝟙 U.sheaf) (ht : t ≫ ε = e₀)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B))
        (pobj : ∀ G, P.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} t (I G))
        (κ : P ⋙ SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 b) ≅ S ⋙ tensorPullback f)
    (hP :
        (∀ (G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (a : G ⟶ G'),
          P.map a = eqToHom (pobj G) ≫
            SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} t (I G)
              (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap f.base A G a) ≫
            eqToHom (pobj G').symm) ∧
        (∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (V : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ) (g : G.val.obj V),
          ((eqToHom (pobj G)).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V))
            ((κ.inv.app G).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
              (((adj₀).unit.app ((S).obj G)).val.app V g)) =
            ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
              (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} t (I G))).app
                ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
                ((1 : B.obj.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V))
                  ⊗ₜ[(IA).obj.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V),(t.hom.app
                    ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom]
                  (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
                    (Opens.map f.base) AddCommGrpCat.{u} (𝓙 X) (𝓙 U)).unit.app
                      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (𝓡 A)).obj G)).hom.app V g)))) :
    ∀ F : U.Modules,
      ∃ δ : P.obj ((R).obj F) ⟶ (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 ε)).obj F,
        ∀ (W : (Opens U)ᵒᵖ) (p : (P.obj ((R).obj F)).val.obj W),
          δ.val.app W p =
            ((adj₀).counit.app F).val.app W ((κ.hom.app ((R).obj F)).val.app W p)
